_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: mean logit sensitivity 1.5, mean logit specificity 2.0

agreement._note: In place of a second language, harness/synthesis_examples.test.py refits the bivariate model with metafor::rma.mv and requires mada::reitsma to match it to 1e-5 (observed 1e-7).

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Both tolerances separate the means from zero. Measured by harness/synthesis_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
